```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,message = FALSE,warning = FALSE)

# Only package we use explicitly
library(ggplot2)
```

Load the Data
```{r}
# Set your working directory
setwd("~/Desktop/CSE160_Real_Estate/")

arrests_raw <- read.csv("NYPD_Arrest_Data_(Year_to_Date)_20251203.csv",
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Structure check
str(arrests_raw)

```

Basic Cleaning & Standardization of Crime Dataset
```{r}
# Start from the raw data
arrests_clean <- arrests_raw

# Convert "(null)" strings to NA in all character columns
char_cols <- sapply(arrests_clean, is.character)

for (col_name in names(arrests_clean)[char_cols]) {
arrests_clean[[col_name]][arrests_clean[[col_name]] == "(null)"] <- NA
}

# Convert ARREST_DATE to Date and extract year and month
arrests_clean$ARREST_DATE <- as.Date(arrests_clean$ARREST_DATE, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

arrests_clean$ARREST_YEAR  <- as.integer(format(arrests_clean$ARREST_DATE, "%Y"))
arrests_clean$ARREST_MONTH <- factor(format(arrests_clean$ARREST_DATE, "%b"),
levels = month.abb)

# Keep only valid borough codes
valid_boros <- c("M", "B", "K", "Q", "S")
arrests_clean <- arrests_clean[arrests_clean$ARREST_BORO %in% valid_boros, ]

# Map borough abbreviations to full names
borough_full <- arrests_clean$ARREST_BORO
borough_full[borough_full == "M"] <- "Manhattan"
borough_full[borough_full == "B"] <- "Bronx"
borough_full[borough_full == "K"] <- "Brooklyn"
borough_full[borough_full == "Q"] <- "Queens"
borough_full[borough_full == "S"] <- "Staten Island"
arrests_clean$BOROUGH <- borough_full

# Drop rows with missing or zeroed-out coordinates
arrests_clean <- arrests_clean[
!is.na(arrests_clean$Latitude) &
!is.na(arrests_clean$Longitude) &
!(arrests_clean$Latitude == 0 & arrests_clean$Longitude == 0),
]

# Make LAW_CAT_CD more readable (F/M/V -> words)
arrests_clean$LAW_CAT_CD[arrests_clean$LAW_CAT_CD == "F"] <- "Felony"
arrests_clean$LAW_CAT_CD[arrests_clean$LAW_CAT_CD == "M"] <- "Misdemeanor"
arrests_clean$LAW_CAT_CD[arrests_clean$LAW_CAT_CD == "V"] <- "Violation"


str(arrests_clean)
summary(arrests_clean$ARREST_YEAR)

```

Keep the useful columns
```{r}
keep_cols <- c("ARREST_KEY","ARREST_DATE","ARREST_YEAR","ARREST_MONTH",
               "BOROUGH","ARREST_PRECINCT","LAW_CODE","LAW_CAT_CD","KY_CD",
               "OFNS_DESC","PD_DESC","AGE_GROUP","PERP_SEX","PERP_RACE",
               "Latitude","Longitude")
arrests_clean <- arrests_clean[, keep_cols]
str(arrests_clean)

```


```{r}
# Build the indicators to aggregate
total_vec       <- rep(1L, nrow(arrests_clean))
felony_vec      <- as.integer(arrests_clean$LAW_CAT_CD == "Felony")
misdemeanor_vec <- as.integer(arrests_clean$LAW_CAT_CD == "Misdemeanor")
violation_vec   <- as.integer(arrests_clean$LAW_CAT_CD == "Violation")

to_agg <- cbind(total_arrests = total_vec,
                felony_arrests = felony_vec,
                misdemeanor_arrests = misdemeanor_vec,
                violation_arrests= violation_vec)

arrests_boro_year <- aggregate(to_agg,by = list(borough = arrests_clean$BOROUGH,
                                                arrest_year = arrests_clean$ARREST_YEAR),
                               FUN = sum,na.rm = TRUE)
arrests_boro_year

```

Total Arrests Bar Plot 
```{r}
latest_year <- max(arrests_boro_year$arrest_year, na.rm = TRUE)

data_latest <- arrests_boro_year[arrests_boro_year$arrest_year == latest_year, ]

ggplot(data_latest, aes(x = borough, y = total_arrests)) + geom_col() + 
  labs(title = paste("Total Arrests by Borough in", latest_year),
       x = "Borough",
       y = "Number of Arrests") + theme_minimal()
```

Write to CSV
```{r}
# Full row-level cleaned dataset
write.csv(arrests_clean, "NYPD_Arrests_Clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Borough-by-year summary
write.csv(arrests_boro_year, "NYPD_Arrests_Borough_Year_Summary.csv",row.names = FALSE)

```
